name: Murdoc's Operation Rejuvination
summary: Murdoc's Operation Rejuvination is a SWF-based mini-game that was available on Gorillaz.com during Phase 2, and later available on the Gonk Bonanza section from the 2006 DVD Phase Two: Slowboat To Hades. It was added to Kong Studios in 2006, and could be played by clicking on 2D’s bed in his room or Murdoc’s bed in his Winnebago.
